name: Richland County, WI
findings: Richland County has 88 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Richland County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Richland County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
